description: This Java class 'RenameComponents' reads a file specifying component name replacements and applies these replacements to all files in a source directory, creating a new set of files in a destination directory with updated component names.

classes.name: RenameComponents
classes.description: A utility class for renaming components in source files based on a replacement request file, processing multiple files in a directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that validates arguments, reads the replacement request, and processes all files in the source directory.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Processes a single source file, applying replacements and writing to the destination directory.

methods.name: processLine
methods.description: Applies all replacements to a single line of code.

methods.name: processLine (overloaded)
methods.description: Replaces specific substrings within a line.

methods.name: readReplaceRequest
methods.description: Reads the replacement rules from a file and populates the replaceMap.

methods.name: assertFolder
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and is valid.
